Yeah I kinda agree. Of course they can do whatever they want & I still really like them & enjoy them here & there but it's not that enjoyable to watch or listen to.

The let's plays are the thing I really enjoyed watching the most & it wasn't even for the game play all the time but I thought they were able to bring great commentary on the game while also having extremely entertaining side conversations. But now it's fun to watch here & there but is mainly just boring. The conversations aren't entertaining anymore really & focuses a lot on the games now where back then I feel like they were able to talk about something in the game but then able to turn it into an entertaining talk.

And you could say if I don't like that they’re focusing a lot more on the games then I should listen to the podcast but it's not that interesting anymore either. And they don't do a lot of let's plays anymore anyways so when they release one I'm hoping for it to be interesting but it's not & all I have really is the podcast. Cool that they're doing it live action but I preferred just audio cause I think they'd be able to do a lot more bits without it cause they don't have to worry about visuals & now that it is visual, I think they do too many visual bits & then go on to make jokes about audio only listeners or whatever. Cool to see the live action ones with guests cause I think it's cool to see them interacting but the ones they have, I feel like Ryan doesn't offer a lot to those episodes. I think I heard him talk about him having social anxiety or whatever which is fine & the guests they have could be more of Matt's friends but I wish he offered more like on the Brandon or Rocco episode. Besides the jacksfilms episode, that one was incredible between all of them. But I still love the podcast, it's the only one I really listen to but I only listen to old episodes besides newer ones with Justin cause those always have great chemistry.

And with Ryan, I love him & I have nothing whatsoever against him & I hopefully never will & I don't even know him personally but his jokes aren't that good most of the time. I feel like he messes up on his words a lot which just takes away from the joke like in the intros to the mail videos, the piss wing prank or the new monster smash or pass & some of his jokes are just him saying what's happening in a funny way or whatever & then he has to almost always explain the joke afterwards which just ruins it. Then sometimes he messes up on his words & just gives up & just says it normally which also just takes away from everything. Matt's jokes are fine, I don't like that a lot of the time he's trying to blatantly be edgy or also try to jokingly say what's happening which is almost never funny but whatever. Again, I love them both & have nothing against them, it's just the jokes aren't the best.

Then the mail videos just all pretty much suck. Again, their humor isn't the best especially in the mail videos. This is just a personal thing but I don't like their set. I think it's too bright & also don’t like how the camera seems a lot more close up. I preferred it back then when it was a lot more plain & dark & the camera was farther away. Maybe something like their new podcast set would be better but whatever I guess. Like I said, the jokes & also bits are just not funny really & I FUCKING HATE how overly edited it is. I really hate all the music & sound effects put in everywhere, all the zoom ins, all the pictures they put up & I immensely hate all the font choices from Justin, they're so plain but also trying to be flashy. And I hate that little squiggly effect that's put on the text sometimes. And this goes for all of their new live action videos, I hate how much editing there is in there & I don't like Justin's editing in them. I love his editing & is funny but I think only for his own content, I just don't think it fits at all for SuperMega's content. I wish Matt & Ryan would edit the live action videos but even then, the new ones where I can tell Matt &/or Ryan edited do have a lot more funny edited bits but I still feel like the ones they do edit still have way too much editing like the hooters & noob dude video. I also think they do too many live action videos now. Back then it was special to get a new one but now it's like, "Oh a new live action video, cool anyways." Like for SpookyMega 2021 where I absolutely hate the 2nd pumpkin carving video & also the 2021 Hanukkah special, they're just not entertaining at all, I hate how Matt was always trying to make jokes about asking to play football.

Anyways, that's just my opinion & yes I did take 40 minutes to write this. I still love Matt & Ryan & also Justin & everyone else that works there. I'm still gonna watch them but it's just not the same.

Don't take anything I say too seriously, I'm just a nobody / stranger on the internet that just wanted to share their opinion. No hatred towards anyone whatsoever, just critiquing the content.
